excerpt.zh: 宇宙风暴经过后，出现了一颗组成成分极不寻常的彗星。它似乎是由有机材料组成的。我们的[solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切想要进行调查。
excerpt.en: A cosmic storm has left behind a comet of unusual composition. It appears to be made of organic material. Our [solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are keen to investigate.

sections.en: A cosmic storm has left behind a comet of unusual composition. It appears to be made of organic material. Our [solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are keen to investigate.

texts.zh:
我们发现这颗彗星实际上是一个巨大的巢穴，里面充斥着微小的昆虫。彗尾也不是冰雾，而是巢穴内部化学反应所排放的废气。

巢穴的外壳由死亡的昆虫组成，这使得内部生的物免受太空恶劣环境的影响。我们还发现了几种依附于巢穴生活的真菌。巢穴中存在一种复杂的共生关系，真菌依赖排放的废气维生，而昆虫则以真菌为食。
texts.en:
The comet was revealed to be a giant nest filled with tiny insects. The tail of the comet is not outgassed ice, but rather exhaust from chemical processes occurring deep inside the hive.

The outer layer of the nest is composed of dead individuals, protecting the living inside from the harsh conditions of space. We've also picked up several types of fungi living in and around the nest. There is a complex symbiosis at work here, with the fungi living off of the exhaust gases and the insects feeding on the fungi.
